items.what: receive_str and receive_bytes must raise the new error on closed/closing messages (instruction names receive_ and generic 'receive_*', but these siblings require the identical change — mechanical propagation)
items.quote: with pytest.raises(WSMessageTypeError, match=f"Received message {WSMsgType.CLOSED}:.+ is not WSMsgType.BINARY")

reason: The instruction specifies the exception class and export but never states the exact message format the tests match against, which admits many reasonable wordings; the receive_str/receive_bytes behavior is a mechanical propagation of the same fix and thus guessable.
